title: CSP Licensing Credit on ClearPath Monthly Fees
content:
The CSP licensing credit on the monthly fee of a ClearPath Managed IT Services agreement reads the license quantity of the client's active Microsoft 365 Business Premium subscription under Microsoft 365 Cloud Subscriptions (CSP), compared with the agreement's seat count.

| Active Microsoft 365 Business Premium licenses | Credit |
|---|---|
| at least the ClearPath seat count | 1.5 percent off |
| one up to the seat count less one | 0.75 percent off |
| no active Business Premium subscription | nothing |

**Hypothetical cases, 40 ClearPath seats.** 40 or more Business Premium licenses: 1.5 percent off. 39 licenses: 0.75 percent off. 1 license: 0.75 percent off. A Business Premium subscription that is no longer active: nothing.
